## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8b66fb370964138bc0109afbef9714259dc92835`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md + scripts/pm/label-write.mjs

Read at 2026-11-16T07:11Z. First review of this head; claim: comment 6909761595; hand-off 6909702546 and lane request 6909717599 on mailbox #33873 (the lane's at-tier reviewer was unavailable). Independence: implemented in an os-steve project thread, dispatched by domain:skills#2 (os-steve); reviewed by os-tesla, who neither dispatched nor implemented it.

Read: the whole diff of the head against its merge base `8559ee1f` (one commit, 2 files, +21/-4), the gate in `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` at this head (header section, `landDogfoodMarkers`, `landDogfoodGate`, `landDogfoodRefusal`, the fold's call site, the `--land` dogfood battery), and, read but not reviewed, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, `references/contract-review.md`, `references/l1-review-checklist.md`, `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` and `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`. Main has moved since the merge base; none of those files changed on it.

Prior ids. S1 of record 6908834893 on PR #34303 (itself S3 of 6908045917): PAID, the clause and its ↔ case are both in this head (④ below; what is left of it is the new S1). N1, N2, N3 of 6908834893: each PAID, pinned by a case in each direction.

### ① Derived judgments

- The clause, `landing-operations.md` line 60: `--land` refuses a `!` / `(narrowing)` pull unless the newest trusted os-dev-report on the card pins dogfood to the head, rule in `os-dev.md`. Against the gate, term by term:
  - which pulls: `landDogfoodMarkers` puts a pull under the gate on `!` before the title's first colon or a `(narrowing)` arm on the `Clause-②:` line, and on nothing else. Agrees. The gate also refuses a pull whose title or declaration line does not read; the clause does not say so and does not need to, since that refusal names its own remedy.
  - whose report: `recordAuthorTrusted` over the delivered card's thread, then `latestMarkedComment`. 「卡上最新受信」 agrees. The sibling exception (the newest names another pull) is detail the clause rightly leaves to the tool.
  - what counts as on the head: the gate reads the sha the `dogfood_battery` string opens with and passes it when it is the head, or when the head reaches it over merges of the base alone. 「钉 head」 is the rule as `l1-review-checklist.md` line 48 and `os-dev.md` line 273 state it; the merge-of-base walk is the gate's tolerance, and a seat that reads the clause strictly errs toward a re-run, never toward a landing. Agrees in the safe direction. The clause does not claim the battery was full or green, which matches the gate's own `sha judged only`.
  - the remedy: the clause states none and points to `os-dev.md`; every refusal the gate prints carries its own `to clear:` text naming the head, the rule path and the report key. Nothing in the clause contradicts those texts. Sufficient for a one-line pointer.
- The clause restates no gate logic (no walk, no fail-closed list, no exit codes), so it cannot drift from them.
- The header's new sentence on a null or URL-less `pr` matches the code: the sibling fallback keeps only reports that read `this`.
- N3: the added remedy is taken on status 404 alone; every other unread keeps the old text. Both halves are asserted in one case.

### ② Semver level

None. `scripts/pm/**` and `.claude/**` are not published; no package, no schema, no changeset owed. `Clause-②: no` on the body is true of this diff: no path under `packages/spec/src/**`. `Metadata-protocol: none` holds.

CI on this head when read: 48 check-runs, 47 complete with no failure (among them Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · ESLint, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard), and 1 still running: Test Core (1/8). This PASS is rendered while that shard runs. The seat waits for it to finish green before `--land`; a red there is not covered by this record.
CI completed before posting: 49 check-runs on this head, 26 success, 23 skipped, none failed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Governed surface: one path under `.claude/**`, Tier S; the pull is a draft and stays the seat's to land after this record. `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` is not on the register.
- Line ratchet: `landing-operations.md` is 112 lines against a ceiling of 112, unchanged; the widest line is 120 bytes and the new one is 111. The new line is an indented continuation of its bullet, the form lines 32, 37 and 82 of the same file already use. No ceiling row moved, no cross-file move declared, none needed.
- Payment: one line added, one deleted. The deleted line 11 (a pull found owing L2 after landing is reviewed on the landed head, findings become cards, the closed pull is never fixed) has its home at `contract-review.md` lines 56 and 57, same direction, in the block the landing pre-check reads, and the deleted line itself pointed there. Line 57 is the more exact text (each must-fix, graded as found). A true deletion of a duplicate, not a re-wrap; not a security-discipline line. The seat asked for this to be judged: it holds. What goes with it is in N3.
- Id lint: the new line carries no card or comment id.
- The diff is the two files the order names. No existing assertion was edited; the battery floor moves 46 to 50 with four cases added, counted in the diff.

### ④ Design judgment

`landing-operations.md`, against the gate it teaches: the clause is true of the gate, sits on the line that teaches `--land`, and gives a landing seat the one fact it lacked, that a marked pull can be refused and where the rule lives. It holds.

`scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`, the ↔ case: from the text side it binds well. It finds the line by `--land` and `(narrowing)` together and requires `!`, dogfood and `os-dev.md` on that same line, so deleting or moving the clause turns it red, and an absent line reads as the empty string and fails. From the gate side it pins `LAND_DOGFOOD_RULE_PATH` to the literal path, so moving the constant turns it red. The behaviour the clause describes is held by the cases of the same battery, whose floor forces them to stay.

S1 (should-fix) — continues S1 of 6908834893, the part of it not yet closed. The case's name says the rule path `holds the !/(narrowing) rule and its report key`, and what it measures is that `os-dev.md` contains the string `(narrowing)` somewhere and the quoted key somewhere. `os-dev.md` carries `(narrowing)` on lines 273, 278 and 373 and the key on line 373, so the rule itself (lines 273 to 275: the full battery once on the final head of a marked pull, count under the key) can be deleted or reversed and the case stays green on the report-shape line alone. The `!` half of the rule is not measured at all. The gate's refusal sends a dev to that file for the rule, so this is the direction a silent drift would hurt. Bind it to one line: a line of `os-dev.md` that carries dogfood, `!` and `(narrowing)` together, as the text side already does for `landing-operations.md`, plus one ablation deleting that line. Not a must-fix: the gate does not read `os-dev.md`, the clause and the gate agree today, and the case is no weaker than the fold's own ↔ case beside it. A follow-up on the card, not a patch round here.

N1 (nit) — new. The 404 remedy reads `or correct the card the body names`, and `deliveredCardNumber` also takes the card from the dev-branch name when the body names none. For such a pull the body names nothing to correct. `the card this pull delivers` would be true of every source.

N2 (nit) — new. The text side of the ↔ case measures tokens, not the sentence: a line that kept the four tokens and dropped 「拒」, 「最新受信」 or 「钉 head」 would pass. The clause says dogfood where the gate reads the `dogfood_battery` key; the full key does not fit the 120-byte line, so the pointer to `os-dev.md` carries it.

N3 (nit) — new. With line 11 gone, `landing-operations.md` no longer tells a landing seat where the owed-after-landing rule lives; its one remaining pointer to `contract-review.md` (line 82) is for the head-move exception. The rule is not lost, only one hop further for this file's reader. No action asked in this PR.

No must-fix.

## Contract review

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept-set and no public surface changes: `scripts/pm/**` and `.claude/**` are unpublished, and no package, schema or exported contract is in the diff. The judgments below are of the rule line against the gate.
- The clause, `landing-operations.md` line 60 continuation: `--land` refuses a `!` / `(narrowing)` pull unless the newest trusted os-dev-report on the card pins dogfood to the head, rule in `os-dev.md`. Right, term by term:

The gate also refuses an unreadable title or a malformed or near-miss declaration line; the clause leaves that to the refusal's own remedy text. Right.
  - whose report: `recordAuthorTrusted` over the delivered card's thread, then `latestMarkedComment`. 「卡上最新受信」 is right. The sibling fallback (the newest names another pull) is tool detail the clause does not restate.
  - on the head: the gate passes the sha `dogfood_battery` opens with when it is the head, or when a first-parent walk over merges of the base reaches it. 「钉 head」 is the stricter reading; a seat that reads it literally errs toward a re-run, never a landing. Right, in the safe direction.
- The header sentence on a null or URL-less `pr`: right. The fallback keeps only reports `reportNamesPull` reads as `this`; `null` is not kept. The new case (older null-`pr` run on the head under a newer report naming pull 9) asserts the refusal, its reason and comment 821.
- The 404 remedy: right. `or correct the card this pull delivers (#N)` is appended on `listed.status === 404` alone; every other unread keeps `land again once the card reads`; both stay exit 3. The wording is now true whether `deliveredCardNumber` took the card from the body or from the branch name. One case asserts both directions (404 has it, a rate-limited read does not).

`landing-operations.md`, against the card's ask and the rules beside it: the card asked for the gate, and review#2 asked for the landing text to say the gate exists.
